text.en:
The following sums, or so much thereof as may be necessary, are hereby appropriated, out of
any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to be at the disposal of the Director of Public
Works for the purposes mentioned hereunder, subject to the provisions hereinafter set forth.
(See Table of ACTS No. 2980 IN PUBLIC LAWS PHILIPPINE LEGISLATURE VOLUME 16 Page 213 to

All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act the destination of which has not yet
been determined by the proper authority on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-two, and all balances
of appropriations which remain unexpended on June thirtieth, nineteen hundred and twenty-three, shall revert
to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury, and thereafter shall not be available for expenditure
except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

The sums appropriated in paragraphs (f), (h), and (n) of this Act shall be available for immediate
expenditure by the Director of Public Works, but those appropriated in the other paragraphs shall be
distributed in the discretion of the Secretary of Commerce and Communications, sunject to the approval of the
presiding officers of both Houses of the Legislature. Subject to the same approval, the Secretary of Commerce
and Communications is authorized, for the purposes of said distribution, to transfer unexpended portions of
any item of appropriation under this Act to any other item hereunder.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 21, 1921.
